description: Azure Landing Zone CAF/WAF Assessment Scoring Configuration

managementGroupHierarchy.name: Management Group Hierarchy
managementGroupHierarchy.description: Assessment of management group structure and organizational hierarchy

rules.name: Management Group Implementation
rules.description: Management groups are implemented for organizational structure
rules.recommendation: Implement a management group hierarchy (e.g., Root > Platform/Landing Zones > Corp/Online)

rules.name: Optimal Hierarchy Depth
rules.description: Management group hierarchy follows CAF recommendations (3-6 levels)
rules.recommendation: Simplify management group structure to 3-6 levels for better manageability

rules.name: Subscription Isolation
rules.description: Multiple subscriptions for workload isolation and scale
rules.recommendation: Adopt subscription democratization: Use separate subscriptions for platform, landing zones, and workloads

policyDrivenGovernance.name: Policy-Driven Governance
policyDrivenGovernance.description: Assessment of Azure Policy implementation for governance and compliance

rules.name: Custom Policies Defined
rules.description: Organization has defined custom policies or initiatives
rules.recommendation: Define custom Azure Policies for security, compliance, and governance requirements

rules.name: Policy Assignments at Scale
rules.description: Comprehensive policy assignments across the organization
rules.recommendation: Assign Azure Policy initiatives (e.g., Azure Security Benchmark, regulatory compliance)

rules.name: Policy Initiatives Usage
rules.description: Using policy initiatives for grouped policy management
rules.recommendation: Group related policies into initiatives for easier management

identityAndAccess.name: Identity and Access Management
identityAndAccess.description: Assessment of RBAC and identity management implementation

rules.name: RBAC Implementation
rules.description: Role-Based Access Control is actively implemented
rules.recommendation: Define and assign Azure RBAC roles at management group and subscription scopes

rules.name: Privileged Role Management
rules.recommendation: Ensure privileged roles follow least-privilege principle and use PIM

networkTopology.name: Network Topology and Connectivity
networkTopology.description: Assessment of hub networking design, security services, DNS, and workload connectivity

rules.name: Hub Network Foundation
rules.description: A hub VNet is present as the foundation for landing zone connectivity
rules.recommendation: Deploy a hub VNet as the foundation for enterprise-scale connectivity

rules.name: Hub Connectivity Services
rules.description: A firewall, VPN gateway, or ExpressRoute circuit provides centralized connectivity
rules.recommendation: Deploy appropriate hub connectivity services such as Azure Firewall, VPN Gateway, or ExpressRoute

rules.name: Private DNS Integration
rules.description: Private DNS zones are configured for name resolution across the landing zone
rules.recommendation: Configure Private DNS zones and links, or an Azure DNS Private Resolver, for landing zone name resolution

rules.name: Workload Connectivity
rules.description: Workload VNets are connected to the hub when they are present
rules.recommendation: Connect workload VNets using peering or Virtual WAN as spokes are deployed

securityGovernance.name: Security and Governance
securityGovernance.description: Assessment of security controls and protective measures

rules.name: Resource Protection
rules.description: Resource locks implemented to prevent accidental deletion
rules.recommendation: Apply CanNotDelete locks on critical resources (networking, shared services)

rules.name: Network Micro-segmentation
rules.description: NSGs protect eligible subnets, or centralized Azure Firewall protection is deployed
rules.condition: nsgEligibleCount == 0 OR nsgProtectedCount >= nsgEligibleCount OR fwCount > 0
rules.recommendation: Deploy NSGs on eligible workload subnets or use Azure Firewall for centralized protection; NSGs are not supported on AzureFirewallSubnet, GatewaySubnet, or RouteServerSubnet

costManagement.name: Cost Management
costManagement.description: Assessment of cost management and financial governance practices

rules.name: Budget Implementation
rules.description: Cost management with budget alerts and monitoring across the collected scope
rules.recommendation: Configure Azure Budgets and Cost Management alerts across workload and platform subscriptions

resourceOrganization.name: Resource Organization
resourceOrganization.description: Assessment of resource tagging and organizational practices

rules.name: Tagging Strategy
rules.description: Comprehensive tagging for resource organization and cost allocation
rules.recommendation: Implement mandatory tagging policy using Azure Policy Modify effect with tags: Environment, CostCenter, Owner, Application

excellent.label: Excellent
excellent.message: Your Azure Landing Zone demonstrates strong alignment with Cloud Adoption Framework best practices.

good.label: Good
good.message: Your Azure Landing Zone follows many CAF best practices with room for enhancement.

fair.label: Fair
fair.message: Your Azure Landing Zone has basic implementation but needs improvement in several areas.

needs-improvement.label: Needs Improvement
needs-improvement.message: Your Azure Landing Zone requires significant work to align with CAF best practices.

notes: This configuration file defines the scoring rules for Azure Landing Zone assessment.
Each category has a maxScore and a set of rules that can award points.
Rules are evaluated based on conditions that check inventory data.
You can adjust points, thresholds, and recommendations to match your organization's requirements.
Version history should be maintained when making changes to this configuration.
